description:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wchill/revanced-patches/compare/v5.15.1...v5.18.1

See https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/releases for official changelog.

Unofficial patch changelog:
* Refactored Boost patches to use OkHttp3 interceptors. This should make it easier to make future changes to API-related patches. (0b406550f1efd717f37864667b9742141d4a243c)
* Add support for undeleting Imgur and Reddit images/albums using Wayback Machine. (ef5415236f8017334328be98c194e112e38ae81c)
* Add long-press context menu options to open a link in Wayback Machine or Archive.is. (c192601bd9d676dd9f591247f18dcc048cfe4e51)
